name: Crescent Refuge
summary: A large crescent shelters a compact, off-center mosque, producing an open circular silhouette.
why: The crescent defines the outer contour, with a clear inner gap around the mosque. The building has a single connected hall and tower, with its dome and doorway aligned at x=60 and a shared foundation at y=73.
risk: The crescent is the dominant first impression; the mosque becomes the second read, especially at 24px.
sub1: Shelter and a quiet Islamic identity
reasonToChoose: You want a crescent-led identity that still holds a clear mosque silhouette.
